name: backblaze-b2
description: Manage cloud storage with Backblaze B2 CLI (v4.x). Upload, download, sync files and folders to B2 buckets. Create and manage buckets, application keys, and lifecycle rules. Use when: backing up files to B2, syncing directories to cloud storage, managing B2 buckets, creating application keys, or troubleshooting unauthorized, bad_auth_token, or Bucket name is already in use errors.
